description: Create a payment request / checkout pay link (you are the RECEIVER asking to get paid). Price in any of 165 fiat currencies; the payer opens the returned payPath, picks one of the offered currencies (rate locks then), and pays a single QR-scannable transfer straight to your address. Requires scope drafts:write.

fiatCurrency.description: Fiat currency the request is priced in, e.g. USD, EUR, SEK

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key. Retries with the same key return the original request

memo.description: Message shown to the payer (max 500 chars)

options.description: Currencies the payer may choose from, each with your receiving address

address.description: The RECEIVER's own address for this currency

currency.description: Asset: Btc, Usdc, Usdt, or Eurc

network.description: Network the address lives on: Mainnet, Solana, Ethereum, or Base

orderId.description: Your own order/reference id, echoed in webhooks for reconciliation

name: create_payment_request
